Column Name: LISTING_STATUS
Table Name: RENTAL_INFORMATION

Description: The LISTING_STATUS column in the RENTAL_INFORMATION table indicates the current status of a rental listing. It could include values such as "Available", "Pending", "Rented", or "Expired". This column helps to track the progress and availability of rental properties in the system.
